segments.text: V. 19. Not being able to bring him in thro' the multitude, they went round about by a back Paſſage, and going up the Stairs on the outſide, they, came upon the flat-roofed Houſe, and let him down thro' the Trap•door, ſuch as was on the Top of moſt of the Jewiſh Houſes: Doubtleſs, with ſuch Circumſpection, as the Circumſtancea plainly required.
